summary: Organize a site reconstruction so documented remains and interpretive additions can be inspected separately.
objective: Build a historical-site diorama with an evidence-layer toggle and dated labels for each reconstructed structure.
example_prompts: Build a historical-site diorama with an evidence-layer toggle and dated labels for each reconstructed structure.

entities.name: Site shell
entities.guidance: Start from a sourced plan when supplied; model wall thickness, door openings and surviving foundation height before roof detail.

entities.name: Reconstructed roof
entities.guidance: Keep conjectural geometry separately selectable; use a neutral hatch or material treatment distinct from documented fabric.

entities.name: Visitor route
entities.guidance: Use human scale markers, grounded paths and conservative wall colliders; camera focus must not hide the evidence legend.

state_contract.model: Editorial scaffold: per-object evidence category, date range, provenance and presentation visibility. No historical site is asserted by this unspecialized recipe.
state_contract.authority: One canonical model owns semantic values; derive geometry and labels from it. Keep presentation transforms separate.
actions: Select a structure to inspect its source or unresolved evidence.
Toggle remains, reconstruction and conjecture independently.

invariants: A reconstructed object cannot be labeled documented without its own source locator.
Keep chronology consistent; do not silently combine phases of a site.
Camera routes respect walls and clearances if first-person navigation is enabled.
motion_guidance: Reveal reconstruction with opacity or separation; label displacement as a presentation device.
Static site by default; people or carts require terrain support and collision contracts before movement.
known_limits: No site, period, asset or historical claim has been verified here; obtain primary site plans and archaeological reports before asserting authenticity.
This creative editorial scaffold is not a certified historical reconstruction.
Authored guidance; no scene runtime or visual verification has run for this recipe.
